mapper.select: select lower(source_path) as src, target_url as target from fly_redirect where status = 1
select id from fly_redirect where source_path = #{sourcePath} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into fly_redirect (id, source_path, target_url, status, create_time) values (#{id}, #{sourcePath}, #{targetUrl}, #{status}, now())
mapper.update: update fly_redirect set target_url = #{targetUrl}, status = #{status} where id = #{id}
